current.validation_rule: Merge, CI, build and deployment are technical states, not user validation.

lot_4_3_closure.accepted_model: One Event represents one Session; Event has one optional editable/createable session_title and no official multi-session workflow.

scope: Advanced Event duplication through the existing Event workflow
phase_0_required_deliverables: No new ADR required because ADR-0001 already defines duplication as a new business creation
No migration plan required because the existing Event schema is sufficient
constraints: Keep session_title as the single session business label
Do not reintroduce the superseded multi-session administration UI
Prefer pre-filling the existing Event form and persisting only after explicit user confirmation
A duplicated provider Event must become an independent manual Event without provider identifiers or copied corrections
No functional implementation before Phase 0 review
No production test data or production mutation during validation
maintainer_decisions_required: Approve empty start/end dates in the duplicated draft
Approve draft status and unpublished defaults
Approve the Web-only approach and list/detail entry points

known_issues: The Agenda view works as a 30-day chronological presentation, but its purpose still requires later UX clarification.
The local npm version can be below the declared npm >= 10 engine requirement; CI, VPS and Windows validation must use the required versions.

next_action.task: Wait for explicit maintainer validation of Lot 4.4 Phase 0. Do not implement functional code, a migration, an API route or a React change before approval.
